text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...First, check their condition in the paddock.
Judging by their last race and workout gallops,
the ones to pay special attention to are...—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone is in top form. But that was within expectations.
If I run just as Trainer evaluated—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A new chapter of racing history, written by these legs...!
